description.value: La Frenz Winery is a family-owned estate established in 1999 on the celebrated Naramata Bench, farming 62 acres across six vineyards with varieties and clones deliberately matched to each site's soils and climate. It earned recognition as #1 Best Performing Small Winery of the Year and #2 Winery of the Year at the 2021 WineAlign National Wine Awards, making it one of the Okanagan's most decorated boutique producers. Cyclists riding the Naramata Bench wine route can stop at the wine shop for tasting flights and bottle purchases.
